model_annotation: The chart illustrates negative log probability values for “per-specialty terms,” showing, for each specialty term set, the values produced by a baseline model and by versions fine-tuned on different specialties. The horizontal axis contains the category groups labeled (left to right) Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, under the axis label “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log probability” and uses a linear numeric scale with tick labels at approximately −22, −23, −24, −25, −26, and −27 (about 1-unit spacing), spanning roughly from −27 at the bottom to −22 at the top. Each category group contains multiple thin vertical bars arranged side-by-side (a grouped bar layout) corresponding to the legend: a light-blue bar for “Mistralv0.2-Base,” followed by six warm-toned bars for models “Fine-tuned on” Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics (in progressively darker beige/brown shades). Approximate values by group are: for Cardio terms, the base bar is around −26.8 and the fine-tuned bars cluster near about −25.7 to −26.1; for Gastro terms, the base bar is about −24.9 and the fine-tuned bars are around −23.9 to −24.2; for Infect terms, the base bar is about −23.7 and the fine-tuned bars are around −22.9 to −23.2; for Neuro terms, the base bar is about −25.4 and the fine-tuned bars are around −24.2 to −24.7; for Obstetrics terms, the base bar is about −24.8 and the fine-tuned bars are around −23.8 to −24.1; and for Pediatrics terms, the base bar is about −24.8 and the fine-tuned bars are around −23.6 to −24.0. The category groups appear in the labeled specialty order rather than being sorted by bar height, and there are no visible outlines, annotations, or other special emphasis applied to particular bars beyond the color coding indicated in the legend.
